decision: Geospatial onboarding selected before local data analysis; human effort estimates are scope-based assumptions, not time studies or supplier quotes.
search_bound: Five candidates; public primary documentation and official wage references; no customer or supplier contact.
candidate_evaluation: Qualitative ranking, not numerical market evidence. Novelty screening is proportionate and not exhaustive.

candidates.beneficiary: Municipal GIS team or civic software supplier onboarding park-linked recreation assets
candidates.outcome: Reproducible two-layer Montreal asset-to-park GeoPackage, traceable reconciliations, unresolved-exception work queue, map, machine checks and handoff
candidates.current_limit: Format conversion alone does not settle agreement between administrative park identifiers and geographic evidence; silently forcing the nearest match loses uncertainty.
candidates.binding_restriction: The buyer needs accountable mixed-source handoff rather than another unverified join.
candidates.transformation: A fixed-scope acceptance contract distinguishes confirmed associations, suggestions and review obligations, allowing useful handoff without pretending that all source-owner facts are resolved.
candidates.construction: Execute actual open municipal geometries with independent readback, source-row conservation, explicit projected CRS and an exception register.
candidates.smallest_experiment: Use one borough for implementation; freeze instrument; execute recipient boroughs and deliberately transformed format inputs.
candidates.buyer_arrangement: Fixed-fee accepted onboarding package and optional bounded update; acceptance includes a complete exception queue, not universal source correction.
candidates.repeat_workload: Similar park/asset onboarding and source updates, with fresh semantic mapping and authority each mission. Demand remains assumed.
candidates.inheritance: Exact-ID/spatial reconciliation instrument, GeoPackage exporter, acceptance SQL and reusable briefing structure.
candidates.novelty_limit: GIS conversion, spatial joins and validators are mature. The study tests packaging, economics and bounded reuse; it does not invent GIS. Prior Ops2.1 NOAA-elevation reuse screening is acknowledged; this selected downstream municipal asset handoff is distinct.

candidates.outcome: Schema mapping, transformed database, row reconciliation, application acceptance and exception pack
candidates.current_limit: Row equality alone cannot prove preservation under semantic schema changes
candidates.transformation: A semantic acceptance contract links source invariants to new queries
candidates.smallest_experiment: Public multi-table fixture with independently checked invariant-preserving migration
candidates.buyer_arrangement: Fixed migration package, outcome conditions and rollback
candidates.reason_not_selected: Excellent business hypothesis but public fixture versus actual application obligations weakens immediate complete-outcome parity; overlaps nearby software-repair lanes.

candidates.beneficiary: Small firms responding to complex public tenders
candidates.outcome: Amendment-aware requirement matrix, change impact and traceable submission checklist
candidates.current_limit: Changes dispersed across documents and attachments need interpretation
candidates.binding_restriction: Versioned requirement meaning and qualified bid responsibility
candidates.transformation: Deliver a bounded evidence pack rather than promising a winning or compliant proposal
candidates.smallest_experiment: Actual original tender plus amendments and frozen independent answer key
candidates.buyer_arrangement: Fixed fee per tender plus amendment monitoring
candidates.inheritance: Version graph and requirement extraction procedures
candidates.reason_not_selected: Live FAR overhaul and tender-specific legal meaning add scope ambiguity; a primary-source reconstruction study is already active.

candidates.outcome: Formula/dependency inventory, reproducible tests, reconciled model and handoff pack
candidates.current_limit: Cell differences do not establish business-meaning equivalence
candidates.binding_restriction: Meaning of model inputs and outputs
candidates.transformation: Convert fragile workbook handoff into executable acceptance obligations
candidates.smallest_experiment: Real open nonfinancial workbook plus independent corrected model
candidates.buyer_arrangement: Fixed model qualification and update package
candidates.reason_not_selected: Strong mature prior art and no matched public workbook/owner-purpose pair identified within the bounded search.

candidates.outcome: Rights-aware packaged collection with integrity manifests, metadata, exceptions and restoration rehearsal
candidates.current_limit: File checksums alone cannot establish usable retained context
candidates.transformation: Sell a restore-tested handoff with unresolved rights/metadata visibly separated
candidates.smallest_experiment: Open collection plus BagIt package and clean-machine restore
candidates.buyer_arrangement: Fixed collection acceptance and periodic verification
candidates.reason_not_selected: Executable but lower supported near-term willingness-to-pay and weaker differentiated outcome.

falsifiers: Buyer requires certified legal boundaries or full source correction, outside offered scope
Independent checks reveal false confirmed associations or dropped source rows
Cheaper competent human service or automated outside option compresses feasible price below complete cost
Acquisition, correction or support costs exceed modeled allowance
Fresh sources need so much semantic rework that retention is not worth its assessment and maintenance cost

historical_alternative_human_reference_u.geography: United States remote GIS service for a public Montreal pilot; monetary values USD unless otherwise stated
historical_alternative_human_reference_u.benefit_reference_period: June 2026, full-time private industry, broad calibration not GIS-specific
historical_alternative_human_reference_u.hours_status: Researcher estimates for the same two-layer deliverable, with competent conventional tools; 4h efficiency challenge recommended
historical_alternative_human_reference_u.nonlabor_overhead: Separate assumed factor, e.g.1.20; do not add employee benefits again.
historical_alternative_human_reference_u.human_service_price: Production cost divided by one minus a separately assumed service margin. Not an observed quote.
historical_alternative_human_reference_u.quality: Record conservation, explicit uncertainties, independently readable package and reproducibility; no field/cadastral/operational certification.
historical_alternative_human_reference_u.turnaround: Proposed 2 business days after valid supplied inputs, not measured commercial SLA.
historical_alternative_human_reference_u.status: Early opportunity-screening alternative only; not the selected economic calibration.

human_reference.estimate_status: Researcher-scoped effort assumptions with competent conventional tools; not observed supplier quotes or measured human trials
human_reference.selected_compensation: 80% GIS wage CAD35.80/h +20% technical-writer wage CAD39.85/h; authoritative source URLs and calibration held in economic configuration.
human_reference.loading: Composite 1.3/1.45/1.7 includes all overhead once; do not add the historical US benefit ratio.
human_reference.complete_scope: Two municipal layers, reproducible GeoPackage, reconciliations, explicit exception queue, map, provenance, acceptance checks and one bounded support allowance.
human_reference.excluded_scope: Survey/cadastral accuracy, field verification, resolution of source-owner facts and production-system writes.
